test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

In every country of the world, __primary caregivers are the women of__ children and elders.

options.text: women are the primary caregivers of
primary caregivers women are of the
women are the caregivers primary of
the women primary caregivers are of

solution:
The correct answer is **'women are the primary caregivers of****'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect placement of the words, which affects the clarity and grammatical structure.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**women are the primary caregivers of**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the original underlined segment of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In every country of the world, women are the primary caregivers of__ children and elders."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "primary caregivers women are of the"** – This option is grammatically incorrect as it disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "women are the caregivers primary of"** – This option is also grammatically incorrect due to improper word order.
 
• **Option 4: "the women primary caregivers are of"** – This option is grammatically incorrect and awkward in structure.
